summary: V5.5.1 REFACTOR-ONLY validation. All three system builders render, save, and navigate correctly — ZERO behavioural regression detected. Circular ESM cycle (Dnd5e↔Anime5e) resolves cleanly because the imports are only used inside render functions.

Both imports are consumed only inside JSX render functions, so the ESM cycle resolves without errors (no white screen, no 'Element type is invalid' in page errors).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: builders/Dnd5e.jsx line 11 imports useParams but never uses it (lint warning). Safe to drop.

Minor: Circular ESM cycle between Dnd5e.jsx and Anime5e.jsx works today because both cross-imports are used only inside render, but it is brittle — any future top-level use (e.g., default-prop resolution or a module-scope const referencing the imported component) would break Anime5e rendering. Consider extracting Anime5eHybridSupplement into its own file (e.g., builders/Anime5eHybridSupplement.jsx) and having both Dnd5e and Anime5e import from there to eliminate the cycle.
No functional or security concerns introduced by this refactor. The loader's edit-vs-new discriminator (regex on /characters/:id/edit$) is correct and preserves prior behaviour.
